definition: A person trained to travel in a spacecraft
examples: The astronaut floated weightlessly in the space station.

definition: To get on or into a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle
examples: Passengers should now board the plane at Gate 5.

definition: A group of people who work on and operate a ship, aircraft, etc.
examples: The cabin crew will serve drinks shortly after takeoff.

definition: A journey made by air, especially in a plane
examples: Our flight to London was delayed by two hours.

definition: A part of an airport where passengers get on or off an aircraft

definition: To enter a place, typically a car or room; to arrive at a destination
examples: What time does your train get in?

definition: To leave a train, bus, or aircraft
examples: We need to get off at the next bus stop.

definition: To step onto a bus, train, ship, or aircraft
examples: He had to run to get on the train before the doors closed.

definition: To leave a closed vehicle, building, etc.

definition: A passenger train that operates at significantly faster speeds than normal trains
examples: The new high-speed train can travel from Paris to Lyon in just two hours.

definition: To come down through the air and rest on the ground or another surface

definition: An instance of coming or bringing something to land, either from the air or from water
examples: The passengers applauded after the pilot made a very smooth landing.

definition: To send a missile, spacecraft, or satellite into the air or space; the act of doing so
examples: The space agency will launch the new satellite next Tuesday.

definition: A dual-carriageway road designed for fast traffic, with relatively few places for joining or leaving

definition: The curved path of a celestial object or spacecraft round a star, planet, or moon; to move in such a path
examples: The satellite was placed into a stable orbit around the Earth.

definition: A traveler on a public or private conveyance other than the driver, pilot, or crew

definition: A raised level surface on which people or things can stand, usually at a railway station

definition: A cylindrical projectile that can be propelled to a great height or distance

definition: A vehicle used for traveling in space

definition: To become airborne (of an aircraft or bird)

definition: An underground railway system in a city, specifically in London

definition: An underground railway system in a city
examples: We took the subway to avoid the traffic jam in the city center.

definition: An informal name for the London Underground

definition: A line or lines of stationary or very slow-moving traffic, caused by roadworks, an accident, or heavy congestion

definition: To work jointly towards the same end

definition: An unfavorable circumstance or condition that reduces the chances of success or effectiveness

definition: To have or express a different opinion

definition: To cease to be visible

definition: Slight pain or feeling of physical unease

definition: To fail to obey rules, a command, or someone in authority

definition: Lacking sense or clear, sound reasoning

definition: Having or showing a tendency to be quickly irritated or provoked
examples: He grew impatient after waiting in line for over an hour.

definition: Not able to occur, exist, or be done

definition: Unable to do or achieve something

definition: Not having all the necessary or appropriate parts

definition: Allowing a two-way flow of information between a computer and a computer-user; influencing each other
examples: The museum has many interactive exhibits that are great for children.

definition: Not even or balanced in shape or arrangement; not happening at regular intervals

definition: Not showing a proper sense of responsibility

definition: To calculate (an amount, distance, or measurement) wrongly

definition: To fail to interpret or understand something correctly

definition: To accept more reservations for (a flight, hotel, etc.) than there is room for
examples: Airlines often overbook flights expecting that some passengers will cancel.

definition: Having too large a population for the area to support
examples: Many modern cities are highly overpopulated, leading to housing shortages.

definition: A student who has successfully completed an undergraduate degree course and is studying for a higher degree
examples: She remained at the university as a postgraduate student to complete her Master's.

definition: To change something so much that it appears to be entirely new
examples: The company managed to reinvent itself and become profitable again.

definition: To write something again so as to alter or improve it

definition: An underground railway system

definition: Lower than zero (typically referring to temperature)

definition: Having or showing exceptional ability or powers

definition: Involving or denoting a speed greater than that of sound

definition: Not able to be believed; unlikely to be true
examples: The team made an unbelievable comeback in the final minutes of the game.

definition: To estimate something to be smaller or less important than it actually is
examples: Never underestimate the importance of a good night's sleep.

definition: Paid too little for the work done

definition: Not expected or regarded as likely to happen

definition: Not likely to happen, be done, or be true; improbable

definition: Not needed

definition: Not achieving the desired result or success

definition: Not habitually or commonly occurring or done

definition: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place
examples: I have a dentist appointment tomorrow afternoon at 3 PM.

definition: To be physically present on a ship, aircraft, or vehicle; to agree or be part of a team/plan

definition: Showing a willingness to take risks; confident and courageous

definition: An instance of one moving object or person striking violently against another
examples: The highway was closed for hours after a multi-car collision.

definition: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition
examples: The factory must adhere to strict environmental regulations.

definition: To undergo natural development by increasing in size and changing physically
examples: Children need a healthy diet to grow strong and tall.

definition: A glacial episode during a past geological period

definition: The action of one object coming forcibly into contact with another; a marked effect or influence

definition: To continue to function well or exist

definition: To search for and find a piece of information in a reference book or database; to improve
examples: If you don't know the word, you can look it up in the dictionary.

definition: Carrying or operated by one or more human beings (especially a spacecraft or vehicle)
examples: The first manned mission to the moon took place in 1969.

definition: A three-dimensional representation of a person or thing or of a proposed structure, typically on a smaller scale
examples: The architect presented a detailed model of the new library building.

definition: A traditional story, especially one concerning the early history of a people; a widely held but false belief or idea
examples: Contrary to popular myth, you don't lose most of your body heat through your head.

definition: Easily agitated or alarmed; tending to be anxious; highly strung
examples: She always gets very nervous before taking a big exam.

definition: A particular time or instance of an event; a special or noteworthy event

definition: Produced or involving production without the use of chemical fertilizers, pesticides, or other artificial agents
examples: She prefers to buy organic vegetables from the local farmers' market.

definition: A thing or collection of things wrapped in paper in order to be carried or sent by mail
examples: The postman delivered a large parcel to our house this morning.

definition: Consisting in or characterized by the presence rather than the absence of distinguishing features; showing optimism or confidence
examples: Maintaining a positive attitude can help you overcome difficult challenges.

definition: Having a child or young developing in the uterus
examples: My sister is six months pregnant and expecting a baby boy.

definition: To increase very rapidly and suddenly
examples: Inflation is expected to rocket in the coming months.

definition: In a manner lacking refinement or gentleness; approximately
examples: There were roughly two hundred people waiting in the queue.

definition: To accumulate money for a specific purpose
examples: They are trying to save up enough money to buy a new house.

definition: An optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer
examples: He used his telescope to observe the rings of Saturn.
